content_sections.heading: About Zila Panchayat Korea
content_sections.text: Zila Panchayat Korea is the district panchayat office at Baikunthpur in Korea district, Chhattisgarh. Its District Mission Management Unit runs "Bihan", the State Rural Livelihood Mission, and is filling this post for the district/block offices of the mission in Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur (MCB) district. The recruitment is approved by the Collector.

content_sections.heading: Zila Panchayat Korea Accountant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years, counted as on 1 January 2026. Age relaxation applies as per the instructions of the General Administration Department issued from time to time for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories. Graduation in Commerce from a recognised university. One-year diploma in computer from a recognised institution/university. 2 years of relevant accounts work experience after graduation in Central/State Government, a local body or a Government-aided institution listed on the NITI Aayog website. Experience certificates are accepted only from government, semi-government or government-funded/aided non-government institutions. For experience in a non-government institution, certified pay-slips or bank statements for 3 continuous months must be attached. Candidates holding a Tally certificate will be given priority. The applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh; a self-attested copy of the residence certificate is required. Only permanent caste and residence certificates issued by the competent authority are accepted. Anyone removed earlier from a post by Chhattisgarh Ajeevika Samvardhan Samiti or any government department for indiscipline, misconduct or irregularity is not eligible. A candidate who married before the minimum legal age, or who married a person with a living spouse (unless the government exempts), is not eligible. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on a merit of 100 marks. If many applications arrive, 10 applicants for the post are called for the interview/skill test in order of merit. The applicant with the highest combined marks is appointed. Marksheets showing only a grade get the average percentage of that grade (an A grade of 80 to 90 per cent counts as 85 per cent). On equal marks, the older candidate is selected first. The next 5 candidates are kept on a waiting list for one year to fill any future vacancy. The selection committee's decision on accepting experience documents is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract appointment is for one year. It may be continued for another year on the basis of work ability, efficiency, Annual Performance Appraisal and conduct, with the consent of both sides. All conditions of General Administration Department memo No. F 9-1/2012/1-3 dated 31 December 2012 on contract appointments apply. Leave is under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules 2012; conduct under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules 1965. Either side can end the contract with one month's notice or one month's pay. No pension, gratuity or death benefit is given for contract service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Zila Panchayat Korea Accountant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application format from korea.gov.in (it is also printed on pages 4 and 5 of the notice). Fill in your name (Hindi and English in capitals), father's/husband's name, gender, date of birth, age as on 01.01.2026, category, addresses, mobile number, email, education and experience details, and marital status, and sign the declaration. Paste a self-attested passport size photo. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates and marksheets; unattested applications are not accepted. For each experience certificate, give the issuing institution's name and full address, outward number, date, issuing officer's name and designation, and a contact phone number and email; otherwise the experience is not counted. Candidates working in a government, semi-government or non-government institution must apply through proper channel with a no objection certificate. Write the name of the post on the envelope; without it the application is rejected. Send it by registered post / speed post to: Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Korea (C.G.), PIN 497335, to reach by 5:00 PM on 16 November 2026. Documents to attach, in this order: High School (10th) certificate Higher Secondary (12th) certificate Graduation certificate Computer degree/diploma certificate Experience/no objection certificate Caste certificate issued by the competent authority Chhattisgarh residence certificate Other certificates Applications sent by any other mode, received late, or incomplete, unclear or faulty will not be considered, and no information will be given about them. Any attempt to influence the process may cancel the candidature. The district level selection committee decides any dispute.

faq.question: Q1. Where will the Accountant be posted?
faq.answer: At district level under Bihan in Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur (MCB) district, though applications go to Zila Panchayat Korea.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply online or by email?
faq.answer: No. Only applications sent by registered post or speed post to the Chief Executive Officer, Zila Panchayat Korea (C.G.), PIN 497335 are accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last time for the application to reach?
faq.answer: 5:00 PM on 16 November 2026; applications received after that are not considered.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates from outside Chhattisgarh apply?
faq.answer: No. Being a native of Chhattisgarh is mandatory, with a self-attested residence certificate.

faq.question: Q5. Does a Tally certificate help?
faq.answer: Yes. Tally certificate holders will be given priority.

faq.question: Q6. How many marks does extra experience carry?
faq.answer: Experience beyond the minimum gives 2 marks per full year up to 10, and Bihan experience gives 1 mark per full year up to 5.

faq.question: Q7. How many candidates will be called for the skill test?
faq.answer: If applications are many, 10 applicants per post are called in merit order for the interview/skill test, which carries 10 marks.

faq.question: Q8. What if my marksheet shows only grades?
faq.answer: You get the average percentage of the grade; for example, an A grade of 80 to 90 per cent is counted as 85 per cent.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: One year, which may be continued for another year based on performance and the consent of both sides.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a waiting list?
faq.answer: Yes. 5 candidates are kept on a waiting list for one year to fill the post if it falls vacant.
